Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Ready for the next step?

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

About Dalux

Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

As soon as possible

****About The Role

**We are looking for an experienced financial-crime leader to be our registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig (HVL

• 7, stk. 2) for Monta Pay ApS under our EMI license and to lead Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) across Monta, group-wide for the Danish/EEA EMI plus UK and US compliance as those markets scale. The role is registered with Finanstilsynet, so the appointment is subject to a fit & proper assessment as a change of key function holder.

Monta Pay ApS holds an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license, granted by Finanstilsynet in April 2026. We are now migrating our financial services from Monta ApS to Monta Pay ApS, with go-live planned for Q2 2027. This is the moment the AML/FCP framework moves from build to live operation, and you will own it.

This is a high-profile, senior role. You sit at the centre of our financial-services compliance strategy as we scale, "directly exposed to the fire." You must balance obligations against resources with a risk-based approach, communicate complex issues clearly to senior leaders and the Board, and run your work-streams with strong, solution-oriented project management. In return, you have an outsized impact on how Monta builds and operates financial services compliance, and direct exposure to decision-making at a fast-growing scale-up.

You report day to day to Nick Skovsen, COO of Monta Pay ApS, with direct, independent access to the CEO and executive management of Monta Pay ApS and to its Board and Governance, Risk & Compliance Committee.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig: Act as the statutory AML-responsible person for Monta Pay under the EMI license. Approve AML/CTF policies and high-risk customer relationships escalated by the first line (PEPs, and business involving high-risk third countries). Receive internal escalations, decide on and file SARs/STRs with the FIU, and be the primary AML contact for Finanstilsynet.

• Own the Financial Crime Prevention framework: Steward Monta's FCP model (our nine-pillar "FC9" framework) covering AML/CFT, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery & corruption. Propose the risk appetite and risk-based approach for Board approval and monitor against it, and keep the framework effective and proportionate to our activities, customer types (B2B & B2C), and transaction flows.

• Fraud, transaction monitoring & customer due diligence: Own the frameworks for fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and KYC/KYB (CDD/EDD, PEP and sanctions screening) across onboarding and the lifecycle (EU and US). Set the rules, thresholds and procedures the Financial Operations team runs in the first line, and assure their quality and effectiveness.

• Sanctions & screening: Set the screening standards (lists, thresholds, re-screening frequency) and assure the quality of first-line alert handling.

• Policy suite, risk assessment & governance: Maintain the AML/CFT policy suite in the Centralised Policy Register (with version control and Board-approval tracking), and own the Business-Wide Risk Assessment (BWRA) and the AML risk assessment underpinning the framework.

• Regulatory reporting: Deliver AML and payments regulatory reporting (for example Section 99 Payment Act, KPSD, AML/CTF returns) and ensure CESOP readiness.

• Technology, controls & assurance: Work with Product and Engineering on case management, screening and monitoring tooling and AI/automation, oversee AML-relevant third parties, and run the internal-controls framework (monitoring, QA, remediation).

• Training, culture & Board liaison: Build AML/FCP training and a strong compliance culture, and advise Senior Management and the Board GRC Committee on financial-crime risk, regulatory change, and performance.

• Build and lead the team: Build out and lead the second-line FCP/AML team as volumes grow post go-live.

What You’ll Walk Into (first 6 to 12 months)

• The foundations are in place; the job is to make them operational for go-live.

• On AML: everything required to obtain the EMI license has been submitted and approved. The remaining gap is operational readiness, and that is the focus: embedding the framework in day-to-day operations and rolling it out with our customers and with colleagues across Monta.

• On FCP: This role brings centralised ownership and direction, consolidating what already exists, formalising it into clear Standard Operating Procedures, and training the relevant teams on them ahead of go-live.

• Concrete early priorities include standing up transaction monitoring and fraud detection, locking v1.0 of the policy suite (Sanctions, PEP, EDD, Outsourcing, and the Sanction-Screening and SAR/STR filing SOPs) into the Centralised Policy Register, building the regulatory-reporting data structure and CESOP readiness, finalising KYC/KYB (EU + US), and securing your Finanstilsynet fit & proper approval ahead of go-live. A structured focus-areas plan accompanies this role.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum 3 years (ideally 5+, given this is a registered key-function role) of relevant experience in the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, ideally in a licensed EMI, payment institution, bank, or regulated fintech. Comparable experience in public authorities, AML consulting, or other AML-regulated sectors (for example gaming/gambling) will also be considered.

• Strong, current understanding of Danish AML law (Hvidvaskloven) and the EU framework (AMLD/AMLR, EBA guidelines), plus sanctions regimes. Awareness of the incoming EU AML package (AMLR + AMLD6, applying July 2027) is a plus.

• Eligibility to pass a Finanstilsynet fit & proper assessment. Prior approval in a fit & proper / key-function role at an EU financial institution is a strong advantage.

• Hands-on experience with fraud prevention and transaction monitoring, and with the underlying tooling (KYC/KYB, screening, monitoring, case management). Data literacy and comfort with AI/automation are a plus.

• Experience across risk controls, compliance, the payments area, credit management, or lines-of-defence leadership. Fintech/scale-up experience is a plus.

• Strong communication skills, autonomy, and sound decision-making, with the ability to build from a blank page and then scale a function and team.

• Analytical and investigative skills to detect patterns and anomalies in financial transactions and to investigate suspicious activity.

• Danish speaking, or willing to learn (the role is regulator-facing).

• Relevant education (economics, mathematics, law, or financial-sector training) is a plus.

• No prior convictions or legal issues that would make the candidate unfit for the role, particularly offences related to financial crime, fraud, money laundering, or other criminal activities undermining trust and integrity.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?
